items.text: Drewton helped Wax shave and change for his wedding to Steris on a water tower outside the church.

Drewton had taken the job with only a rough idea of how often his employer landed in danger. Traveling to New Seran with Wax's party, he was caught in a shootout on the train, pestered Marasi about the fate of Wax's last valet as she fought, and swore at her over a near miss. Afterward he sat with tea among nurses, complaining loudly.
Back in Elendel, Drewton kept serving as Wax's valet in the penthouse, carefully setting out the belongings left from Wax's New Seran trip on a cloth on the dressing table.
